Get stronger legs in just 7 minutes with this quick and effective leg workout for women! This at-home strength training workout requires no equipment, making it easy to fit into your day whenever you need a fast lower-body workout.
This 7-minute leg workout focuses on strengthening and toning the legs, thighs, glutes, and lower body using simple bodyweight exercises you can do at home. It's a great option when you're short on time but still want to work your lower body.
